subject: Mathematics
main_theme: Understanding numbers up to 10 and different ways of making 10
core_concepts: Number names and numerals up to 10
Finding the missing number to make 10
activities: Use fingers to show different ways of making 10
Combine two groups of objects to make 10
Find the missing number in number combinations that make 10
Use pictures and objects to practise making 10
Complete simple number patterns up to 10
Count forward and backward using objects
learning_outcomes: Count and recognise numbers up to 10
Combine two groups to make a total of 10
Find a missing number in a number combination that makes 10
Use objects and fingers to represent numbers
Develop an early understanding of addition
